states.completed: The explicitly bounded acceptance scope passed its named tests. This does not complete broader engine features.
states.in_progress: Implementation or validation is actively under way; acceptance has not yet passed in full.
states.partial: A useful subset has verified evidence, with substantial scope still unimplemented or unverified.
states.pending: Planned work with no completed implementation/acceptance evidence for this scope. Prerequisites do not imply an external blocker.
states.blocked: Work cannot proceed because a named, actual dependency or external condition is unavailable; record the blocker.
states.deferred: Intentionally postponed optional work; no commitment to implement or delivery date.

items.title: CPU foundation
items.scope: Dependency-free C++20 build and original affine tetrahedral-cell math; not cage preprocessing or GPU cage traversal.
items.acceptance: 78 CPU correctness checks; Linux and Windows CPU/docs CI passed for implementation commit 923d10b. Contains no performance or visual-quality acceptance.
items.next_test: Repeat CPU correctness and documentation checks after affected math/build changes.

evidence.summary: 78 local CPU checks; Ubuntu and Windows CPU/docs CI run 40677723983 on commit 923d10b.

items.title: GPU pointer-root foundation
items.scope: Pinned NoGraphicsAPI preparation and one Slang pointer-root ABI on the named Windows/Vulkan adapter.
items.acceptance: 4096 output pixels match independent CPU arithmetic on RTX 4090/NVIDIA 617.42. Cross-vendor and independent SPIR-V validation remain outside this scope.
items.next_test: Preserve the pointer-root oracle while enabling validation and adding texture transitions.

evidence.summary: 4096 pointer-root GPU pixels matched the CPU oracle on the stated local configuration.

items.title: Ordinary hardware-ray seam
items.scope: Same-device Vulkan BLAS/TLAS and static/translated ray queries using native command scopes.
items.acceptance: 8192 analytic ray-query oracle comparisons pass across two transforms. No DXR2, PT, SDK or GPU-cage completion follows.
items.next_test: Repeat ray oracles with validation and the native-texture path enabled.

evidence.summary: 8192 ordinary hardware ray-query checks passed; no validation-layer pass claimed in this receipt.

items.title: Harden native interop
items.scope: Validation, native texture/resource-state contract, SDK transitions and lifecycle behavior.
items.acceptance: All M1b subgates have passing evidence under their named scopes. A texture smoke test alone does not prove SDK or window/device recovery.
items.next_test: Actual optional SDK state/evaluation, broader lifecycle and window/device-failure handling remain pending.

evidence.summary: Verified Debug/SyncVal harness: five cases, three positive cycles, 12288 pointer pixels, 24576 rays, 25500 texture checks, 63 contract rejections; zero diagnostic logs.

items.title: Validation-enabled GPU correctness
items.scope: Named local Debug core/SyncVal run plus whole-process log scan, pinned validation package and missing-shader/image-write/Release-rejection cases. One RTX4090 configuration only.
items.acceptance: Pointer/ray/texture workloads pass with validation enabled; record layer versions and relevant diagnostics.
items.next_test: Preserve these checks when adding native textures or real SDK calls; broaden hardware coverage separately.

evidence.summary: Verified Debug/SyncVal harness: five cases, three positive cycles, 12288 pointer pixels, 24576 rays, 25500 texture checks, 63 contract rejections; zero diagnostic logs.

items.title: Native texture and layout contract
items.scope: Controlled same-device/same-queue RGBA8 2D images: GENERAL/transfer layout transitions, native compute and explicit NoGraphicsAPI heap/PSO restore; registry-issued tickets and fence-gated retirement.
items.acceptance: 25500 exact pixel checks over 64x64,17x9,1x1 extents across three cycles and 63 metadata/stale-ticket/retirement rejections pass with requested SyncVal. This is not an actual SDK evaluation.
items.next_test: Add actual reconstruction SDK resource tagging/evaluation using this contract; multi-queue/format/view cases remain outside the tested scope.

evidence.summary: Verified Debug/SyncVal harness: five cases, three positive cycles, 12288 pointer pixels, 24576 rays, 25500 texture checks, 63 contract rejections; zero diagnostic logs.

items.title: External SDK state restoration
items.scope: Resource tagging and state restoration around an actual optional reconstruction SDK evaluation.
items.acceptance: Actual supported SDK evaluation followed by correct engine read/write; record runtime, adapter and required resource semantics.
items.next_test: Introduce one optional SDK adapter only after the native texture contract passes.

items.title: Repeated resource lifecycle
items.scope: Nine offscreen image lifecycles across three cycles and negative retirement guards are tested. Repeated device creation and real asynchronous/in-flight release scenarios remain unverified.
items.acceptance: Repeated create/destroy and in-flight retirement tests pass without stale handles or validation errors.
items.next_test: Add repeated device sessions and actual in-flight retirement requests before completing the broad lifecycle gate.

evidence.summary: Verified Debug/SyncVal harness: five cases, three positive cycles, 12288 pointer pixels, 24576 rays, 25500 texture checks, 63 contract rejections; zero diagnostic logs.

items.title: Window resize and device loss
items.scope: Window/swapchain resize and explicit device-loss/recovery behavior; current headless test does not cover this.
items.acceptance: Resize tests preserve correct resources/states; device loss produces documented recovery or a clean actionable failure.
items.next_test: Add the required window/device-failure harness before claiming coverage.

items.title: Reference renderer and materials
items.scope: Stable scene/material IDs, import, shared BSDF and progressive reference PT.
items.acceptance: Convergence, BSDF PDF/energy tests and motion-guide clips pass.
items.next_test: Start a minimal material/scene representation and analytic reference scene.

items.title: Many lights and reconstruction
items.scope: Original direct lighting/fallback denoising, optional RTXDI, SR then RR; no vendor SDK is currently integrated.
items.acceptance: Equal-error captures, temporal tests, separate licensing and a non-DLSS path.
items.next_test: Establish a brute-force light/reference baseline before sample reuse or reconstruction.

items.title: DLSS integration
items.scope: Optional SR followed by RR through explicit native resource/guide adapters; frame generation separately scoped.
items.acceptance: Actual SDK evaluation, support checks, guide correctness, resets and fallback pass.
items.next_test: Select a pinned licensed adapter and test SR inputs/output before RR.

items.title: Geometry and streaming contract
items.scope: Stable clusters, codec tags, residency generations, source triangle/material provenance and conventional BLAS.
items.acceptance: Deterministic cook, bounded residency and stale-handle rejection.
items.next_test: Prototype a small original geometry manifest and provenance tests.

items.title: Tetrahedral cage pipeline
items.scope: Original affine-cell CPU math is verified; cage generation, clipping, attributes and GPU adjacent-cell traversal remain open.
items.acceptance: Independent deformed-triangle comparison, seam/grazing tests and invalid-deformation fallback; fast method never called watertight.
items.next_test: Implement triangle clipping/provenance and independent coverage tests before GPU cage work.

evidence.summary: 78 CPU checks cover the affine-cell mathematical layer only.

items.title: GPU cages and shared boundaries
items.scope: Adjacent-cell micro-BLAS tracing, motion history and deformation correctness; not implemented by ordinary triangle ray smoke.
items.acceptance: GPU adjacent-cell results match independently deformed geometry within declared tolerances; handle duplicates/leaks and invalid cages.
items.next_test: Complete clipping/provenance first, then compare two adjacent cells against an independent triangle reference.

items.title: Optional clustered acceleration structures
items.scope: NV cluster experiment and later separate standard DXR2 adapter; advertised device extensions are not implementation evidence.
items.acceptance: Queried support plus CLAS to cluster BLAS to TLAS trace, move/retire and residency lifetime checks.
items.next_test: Pin an actual usable API/runtime/driver combination and run the smallest cluster-AS oracle.

items.title: Geometry comparison
items.scope: Compare conventional skin/refit, rigid instances, clusters and cages on repeated and diverse assets.
items.acceptance: Full-frame/AS timings, peak memory and image/deformation error under an explicit common workload.
items.next_test: Define the matched workloads and quality budgets before performance claims.

items.title: Playable game slice
items.scope: Streaming scene, animation, physics/audio/input, save/load and packaged assets.
items.acceptance: Reproducible playable encounter with declared target hardware and content.
items.next_test: Choose the intended scene/gameplay workload after renderer correctness is established.

items.title: Optional rendering research
items.scope: DGF/DGFS, LinAlg, neural caches, Work Graphs and future Work Lists are independently optional.
items.acceptance: A candidate beats its baseline within a stated quality/memory budget with verified availability and licensing.
items.next_test: Select one measured bottleneck and an available candidate; no future standard is mandatory.
